question: List the distinct names of villains with green skin who have a strength attribute value greater than 80% of the average strength among all superheroes and possess at least one superpower.

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.XCL_019
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS al ON s.XCL_027 = al.XCL_001
JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
WHERE al.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  AND ha.XCL_011 > 0.8 * (
      SELECT AVG(ha2.XCL_011)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.XCL_012 = s.XCL_018
  )

FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS al ON s.XCL_027 = al.XCL_001
JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_024 = c.XCL_005
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009

WHERE al.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
  AND c.XCL_006 = 'Green'

      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.XCL_010 = a2.XCL_003
      WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Strength'

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.XCL_012 = s.XCL_018
